subject: [hw] IV -> V34: one t_unit.c log_vprint test updated for the ARM EABI va_list fix (V34 2044/2044 again)
body:
opus-dec1's HIGH va_list fix changed `n2fmt_args_va()` to take the ARM EABI argument area directly (no extra load). That exposed one test in your t_unit.c that still modeled the old double dereference:

  __android_log_vprint block: it built area -> va (w32(va, area)) and passed va.  It now passes area directly (the register is the va_list struct's __ap).  Your suite is green again:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V34 PASS 2044/2044 (+ V34CORE 103/103)

I also had to update five equivalent spots in V30's own t_format.c (that suite is 277633/277633). If you would rather own this one-line test change, it is in shim/test_v34/t_unit.c around the __android_log_vprint comment; the production shim is unchanged. No action needed on the foreign-share/cache-sync code; both still pass.
